items.description: On Booking.com, attempt a search for Amsterdam with check-in Sep 15, 2026 and check-out Sep 18, 2026 (3 nights), for 2 adults, 1 room. Full credit if all inputs match exactly OR if the agent is blocked (captcha/site error) after a clear attempt and explicitly reports the issue. Partial credit if one parameter is initially off but corrected later. No credit if the search remains for a different city or materially different dates/occupancy without correction when correct inputs were available.

items.criterion: Apply required visible filters (rating and budget) where available
items.description: Apply visible Booking.com filters for guest rating 8+ and total budget < €750 for the full stay, when such controls are available/visible. Full credit if both filters are applied, OR if one/both filters are not available/applicable (e.g., only per-night pricing filter, no total-price slider) and the agent clearly notes the limitation while still enforcing the constraints by manually selecting only properties that meet rating ≥ 8 and total < €750 (as displayed). Partial credit if only one filter is applied and the other constraint is enforced manually (or vice versa). No credit if filters/constraints are ignored despite being available and qualifying options are not preferentially selected.

items.criterion: Open and review Hotel 1 that qualifies (or best available if none qualify)
items.description: Open a first property from the results and capture: total price for the 3-night stay (as displayed), guest rating, neighborhood/location area, cancellation terms, and distance from city center. Full credit if the hotel meets rating ≥ 8 and total < €750 and all fields are captured. If no options meet both constraints, full credit for selecting the closest match that preserves primary intent (Amsterdam, specified dates, high guest rating and/or closest to budget) and explicitly stating which constraint(s) could not be met and why (based on visible results). Partial credit if one comparison field is missing/unclear after reasonable effort (e.g., cancellation terms require selecting a room and the agent attempts but cannot view). No credit if the agent picks a clearly worse match while better/qualifying options are visible and available.

items.criterion: Open and review Hotel 2 that qualifies (or best available if none qualify)
items.description: Open a second property and capture: total price for the 3-night stay, guest rating, neighborhood/location area, cancellation terms, and distance from city center. Full credit if it qualifies (rating ≥ 8 and total < €750) with all fields captured, OR if no qualifying options exist and the agent selects a reasonable next-best alternative and clearly documents the unmet constraint(s). Partial credit if one field is missing/unclear despite reasonable effort. No credit if it is a poor choice relative to visible better/qualifying options.

items.criterion: Open and review Hotel 3 that qualifies (or best available if none qualify)
items.description: Open a third property and capture: total price for the 3-night stay, guest rating, neighborhood/location area, cancellation terms, and distance from city center. Full credit if it qualifies with all fields captured, OR if no qualifying options exist and the agent selects a reasonable next-best alternative and clearly documents the unmet constraint(s). Partial credit if one field is missing/unclear despite reasonable effort. No credit if it is a poor choice relative to visible better/qualifying options.

items.criterion: Compare the three hotels on required dimensions
items.description: Provide a comparison across the three opened properties explicitly covering for each: total price, rating, neighborhood, cancellation terms, and distance from city center. Full credit if all five dimensions are compared for all three. Partial credit if one dimension is missing or not clearly tied across all three (especially if that dimension was not retrievable due to page limitations and the agent notes it). No credit if no meaningful comparison is provided.

Recommend one of the reviewed properties with rationale grounded in the comparison factors (price, rating, neighborhood, cancellation, distance) and explicitly avoid completing a booking/checkout. Full credit if a clear recommendation is made and the agent stops short of booking. Partial credit if recommendation rationale is weak or not tied to the required factors. No credit if the agent attempts to finalize a booking or provides no recommendation.
